description: This file defines the HL7DAO interface which declares methods for database operations related to HL7 messaging components in the OpenMRS system, including sources, queues, archives, and errors.

classes.name: HL7DAO
classes.description: This interface declares data access methods for HL7 message components such as sources, queues, archives, and errors within the OpenMRS HL7 module.

methods.name: saveHL7Source
methods.description: Saves or updates an HL7 source in the database.

methods.name: getHL7Source
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7 source by its unique ID.

methods.name: getHL7SourceByName
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7 source by its name.

methods.name: getAllHL7Sources
methods.description: Returns a list of all HL7 sources.

methods.name: deleteHL7Source
methods.description: Deletes an HL7 source from the database.

methods.name: saveHL7InQueue
methods.description: Saves or updates an HL7 message in the queue.

methods.name: getHL7InQueue
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7 message from the queue by ID.

methods.name: getHL7InQueueByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7 queue entry by its UUID.

methods.name: getAllHL7InQueues
methods.description: Returns all HL7 in-queue entries.

methods.name: getNextHL7InQueue
methods.description: Retrieves the next HL7 message in the queue.

methods.name: deleteHL7InQueue
methods.description: Deletes an HL7 queue message.

methods.name: getHL7Batch
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of HL7 messages filtered by class, start index, length, message state, and query.

methods.name: countHL7s
methods.description: Counts HL7 messages in the database based on class, message state, and query.

methods.name: saveHL7InArchive
methods.description: Saves or updates an HL7 message in the archive.

methods.name: getHL7InArchive
methods.description: Retrieves an archived HL7 message by ID.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7 archive entry by UUID.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveByState
methods.description: Retrieves archived HL7 messages by their state.

methods.name: getHL7InQueueByState
methods.description: Retrieves HL7 queue entries by their state.

methods.name: getAllHL7InArchives
methods.description: Returns all HL7 archives.

methods.name: deleteHL7InArchive
methods.description: Deletes an HL7 archive entry.

methods.name: getHL7InArchivesToMigrate
methods.description: Returns a list of HL7 archives pending migration.

methods.name: saveHL7InError
methods.description: Saves or updates an HL7 error record.

methods.name: getHL7InError
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7 error record by ID.

methods.name: getHL7InErrorByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7 error record by UUID.

methods.name: getAllHL7InErrors
methods.description: Returns all HL7 error records.

methods.name: deleteHL7InError
methods.description: Deletes an HL7 error record.

methods.name: garbageCollect
methods.description: Performs garbage collection for the HL7 data.
